name: Maxan Anvol
summary: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Maxan Anvol teaches dwarven priests the ways of the Holy Light. Before acolytes earn the Church’s vestments, he puts their faith to the test.

sections.title: A Priest in the Pub
sections.body: From the Thunderbrew Distillery, Maxan Anvol tends to the spiritual needs of Kharanos. Travelers, mountaineers, and acolytes gather there, for the hamlet lies between Coldridge Valley and Ironforge. Its inn draws those passing through. Maxan offers prayer and counsel to all who enter, with stout close at hand.

sections.title: Testing the Faithful
sections.body: Before novice priests venture into the wider world, Maxan Anvol tests their faith and skill. He sends initiates to use simple healing prayers on Dun Morogh’s wounded defenders. Those who prove devoted and skilled receive their first priestly vestments, a mark of their place in the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Where can I find Maxan Anvol?
faq.answer: You can find Maxan Anvol inside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. The inn is a gathering place for the town and for travelers crossing Dun Morogh.
Maxan Anvol teaches novice and journeyman priests holy healing, shadow control, and divine protection. Dwarven priests can also learn prayers such as Desperate Prayer.

faq.q: Why is a holy priest hanging out in a distillery?
faq.answer: Dwarven life and celebration gather around brewing and taverns. The Thunderbrew Distillery is Kharanos’s public gathering place and a rest for travelers, where Maxan offers spiritual comfort to townsfolk, guards, and passersby.

faq.q: Does Maxan Anvol offer any special tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. Maxan Anvol tests aspiring priests in trials such as 'In Favor of the Light' and 'Garments of the Light.' He sends them to heal injured mountaineers in the snow, and those who succeed earn their acolyte robes.

faq.q: What does he say to non-priests?
faq.answer: Maxan Anvol warns adventurers never to turn their backs on the Holy Light. Divine grace may save their lives in battle.

faq.q: Can gnomes learn from Maxan Anvol?
faq.answer: Yes. Gnomes can train as priests, and Maxan welcomes any member of the Alliance who has pledged to the Light.

angles.text: As a priest, you meet Maxan Anvol early in Dun Morogh and begin learning the foundations of holy discipline. He teaches racial prayers such as Desperate Prayer and gives you your first church robes.
As a dwarf, you see Ironforge’s practical faith where people gather, beside Kharanos’s ale kegs.
As an Alliance member, you find Maxan tending to the physical and spiritual readiness of mountaineers and scouts who guard Dun Morogh from troggs, frost trolls, and wilderness beasts.
